title: Modal 了 (Change of State)
simpleExplanation: Put 了 at the end of a sentence to show that the situation has changed or just started happening.
technicalExplanation: Sentence-final 了 is a modal particle indicating a new situation or a currently relevant state. It does not simply mark past tense but signals that the speaker considers the event relevant to the present moment.
usage: Announcing changes: 下雨了, 我懂了, 他来了.
avoidWhen: Do not use it for habitual or generic statements: 我每天喝茶 (not 我每天喝了茶).

negativeExamples.note: Habitual actions should not take 了.
negativeExamples.note_en: Habitual actions should not take 了.

commonMistakes: Using 了 for all past actions; confusing modal 了 with perfective 了.

title: 会 (Ability and Likelihood)
simpleExplanation: 会 expresses either a learned ability ('can/know how to') or a future likelihood ('will').
technicalExplanation: 会 has two distinct usages: (1) ability acquired through learning (我会游泳), and (2) a future possibility that the speaker feels is likely (明天会下雨). Unlike 能, which expresses physical ability or permission, 会 emphasizes knowledge or prediction.
usage: Skills and future predictions: 我会说中文, 明天会更好.
avoidWhen: Do not use 会 for present physical ability where 能 is more appropriate.

examples.pinyin: wǒ huì shuō yī diǎn zhōng wén

negativeExamples.note: Use 要 or 想 for immediate plans, not 会.
negativeExamples.note_en: Use 要 or 想 for immediate plans, not 会.
negativeExamples.note_id: Pakai 要 atau 想 untuk rencana segera, bukan 会.

commonMistakes: Confusing 会 with 能; using 会 for present physical abilities where 能 is correct.
simpleExplanation_en: 会 expresses either a learned ability ('can/know how to') or a future likelihood ('will').
simpleExplanation_id: 会 menyatakan kemampuan terpelajar ('bisa/tahu bagaimana') atau kemungkinan masa depan ('akan').
technicalExplanation_en: 会 has two distinct usages: (1) ability acquired through learning (我会游泳), and (2) a future possibility that the speaker feels is likely (明天会下雨). Unlike 能, which expresses physical ability or permission, 会 emphasizes knowledge or prediction.
technicalExplanation_id: 会 punya dua pemakaian berbeda: (1) kemampuan yang didapat lewat belajar (我会游泳), dan (2) kemungkinan masa depan yang dirasa mungkin (明天会下雨). Berbeda dari 能 yang menyatakan kemampuan fisik atau izin, 会 menekankan pengetahuan atau prediksi.
usage_en: Skills and future predictions: 我会说中文, 明天会更好.
usage_id: Keterampilan dan prediksi masa depan: 我会说中文, 明天会更好.
avoidWhen_en: Do not use 会 for present physical ability where 能 is more appropriate.
avoidWhen_id: Jangan pakai 会 untuk kemampuan fisik saat ini yang lebih tepat pakai 能.
commonMistakes_en: Confusing 会 with 能; using 会 for present physical abilities where 能 is correct.
commonMistakes_id: Mengacaukan 会 dengan 能; memakai 会 untuk kemampuan fisik saat ini yang benar pakai 能.
